data.context: In WIPO’s *Global Innovation Index 2026*, the “Construction & Materials” part of Figure 5 shows growth rates from 2024 to 2025 for leading corporate R&D spenders in the industry. Dashed vertical lines indicate the industry sample’s average R&D growth; the figure is based on Moody’s Orbis and the 2025 EU Industrial R&D Investment Scoreboard.
